home_subtitle: Create MVP votes for your matches and let your players decide who stood out.
home_create_poll_desc: Set up a new MVP vote for your players.
home_manage_players_desc: Add, edit, or remove the players who can be voted for.
home_view_latest_poll_desc: Check on votes or manage your most recent poll.
create_match_details_desc: Enter basic details about the match.
create_roster_desc: Pick who's votable — visitors will choose two of these players as MVP.
create_no_players_before_link: No active players yet. Add some in
create_error_roster_min: Pick at least two players for the roster.
players_delete_confirm_desc: This permanently deletes {name} and removes them from any poll rosters and votes. This action cannot be undone.
players_error_name_required: Enter both first and last name.
players_error_jersey_range: Enter a jersey number between 0 and 99.
players_error_jersey_taken: That jersey number is already taken.
manage_controls_desc: Open voting when you're ready, then close it once everyone has voted.
manage_public_link_desc: Share this link or QR code with your players so they can cast their vote.
manage_qr_alt: QR code linking to the poll
manage_danger_zone_desc: Permanently delete this poll and all of its votes.
manage_delete_confirm_desc: This permanently deletes "{title}" and all votes cast for it. This action cannot be undone.
login_subtitle: Enter the team passcode to create or manage a match poll.
vote_results_shown_when_closed: Results will be shown once the poll is closed.
selected_players_desc: The players eligible to receive votes in this poll, ranked by vote count once voting closes.
vote_rejected_poll_not_open: Poll is not open for voting
vote_rejected_invalid_picks: A ballot must contain exactly two distinct picks
vote_rejected_not_on_roster: Both picks must be on the poll roster
vote_rejected_already_voted: This browser has already voted in this poll
